name: s3_bucket
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS S3 bucket.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this S3 bucket.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the S3 bucket.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this bucket to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group this bucket belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: AWS region the bucket is created in (e.g. us-west-2).

attributes.name: enable_versioning
attributes.description: Enable object versioning on the bucket.

attributes.name: encryption_type
attributes.description: Server-side encryption: Sse (S3-managed), SseKmsAwsManaged (AWS-managed KMS), or SseResourceGroupKms (resource-group KMS key).

attributes.name: kms_key_id
attributes.description: KMS key ID used when encryption_type is a KMS mode.

attributes.name: enable_object_lock
attributes.description: Enable S3 Object Lock (can only be set at bucket creation).

attributes.name: object_ownership
attributes.description: Object ownership / ACL behavior.

attributes.name: block_public_access
attributes.description: S3 Block Public Access settings.

attributes.name: block_public_acls
attributes.description: Block new public ACLs.

attributes.name: ignore_public_acls
attributes.description: Ignore existing public ACLs.

attributes.name: block_public_policy
attributes.description: Block public bucket policies.

attributes.name: restrict_public_buckets
attributes.description: Restrict access to buckets with public policies.

attributes.name: policies
attributes.description: Names of managed policies to attach to the bucket.

attributes.name: bucket_policy
attributes.description: Inline bucket policy as a JSON string.

attributes.name: cors_rules
attributes.description: CORS rules for the bucket.

attributes.name: allowed_methods
attributes.description: Allowed HTTP methods (e.g. GET, PUT).

attributes.name: allowed_origins
attributes.description: Allowed origins.

attributes.name: allowed_headers
attributes.description: Allowed request headers.

attributes.name: expose_headers
attributes.description: Response headers exposed to the browser.

attributes.name: max_age_seconds
attributes.description: Preflight cache duration in seconds.

attributes.name: user_tags
attributes.description: User-defined tags applied to the bucket.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: s3_bucket_id
attributes.description: ID of this S3 bucket, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: bucket_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned bucket.

attributes.name: bucket_domain_name
attributes.description: Domain name of the provisioned bucket.

failureStates.WaitingForApproval: provisioning is waiting for manual approval, which Terraform cannot provide
